name: Tom Homan
summary: Tom Homan, a 30-year immigration-enforcement veteran who was acting director of ICE in Trump’s first term, has been the White House “border czar” since January 2025, an informal title overseeing border and deportation operations. Between the two administrations he was a visiting fellow at the Heritage Foundation and a contributor to Project 2025. Democrats have pressed for an inquiry into reports that he accepted $50,000 in cash from undercover FBI agents in 2024.
